mapper.sql: id, name, map_model_url, player_character_json, player_spawn_json, robot_spawn_json, robot_story, story_graph_json, zombie_spawns_json, placed_objects_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM levels ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO levels ( id, name, map_model_url, player_character_json, player_spawn_json, robot_spawn_json, robot_story, story_graph_json, zombie_spawns_json, placed_objects_json ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{request.name}, #{request.mapModelUrl}, #{request.playerCharacterJson}, #{request.playerSpawn,typeHandler=com.innervix.model3d.common.mybatis.Vector3JsonTypeHandler}, #{request.robotSpawn,typeHandler=com.innervix.model3d.common.mybatis.Vector3JsonTypeHandler}, COALESCE(#{request.robotStory}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.storyGraphJson}, ''), '{"nodes":[],"edges":[],"variables":[]}'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.zombieSpawnsJson}, ''), '[]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.placedObjectsJson}, ''), '[]') ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), map_model_url = VALUES(map_model_url), player_character_json = VALUES(player_character_json), player_spawn_json = VALUES(player_spawn_json), robot_spawn_json = VALUES(robot_spawn_json), robot_story = VALUES(robot_story), story_graph_json = VALUES(story_graph_json), zombie_spawns_json = VALUES(zombie_spawns_json), placed_objects_json = VALUES(placed_objects_json)
